prompts.title: Humorous Best Friend Birthday Roast
prompts.description: A perfect blend of affectionate teasing and deep appreciation for your closest friend.
prompts.text: Write a hilarious, lighthearted birthday roast card for my best friend [Friend Name]. We have known each other for [Number] years and we always joke about [Insert inside joke/habit, e.g., their terrible sense of direction]. Start with a funny roast about their age or habit, transitioning into a deeply sincere and emotional message about why their friendship means the world to me. Keep the tone Gen-Z inspired, witty, and warm.
prompts.usageInstructions:
1. Replace bracketed fields like [Friend Name] with real values.
2. Paste into ChatGPT or Claude.
3. Copy the resulting output and send it in a card or message!
variables: Insert inside joke/habit, e.g., their terrible sense of direction

prompts.title: Deep Philosophical Birthday Letter
prompts.description: An elegant, thoughtful letter focusing on self-reflection, growth, and the beauty of time.
prompts.text: Compose a beautiful, reflective, and stoic-inspired birthday letter for [Name] who is turning [Age]. Focus on the themes of time as a gift, the beauty of personal growth over the past year, and the excitement of the unwritten chapters ahead. Write in an elegant, literary prose style, drawing soft inspiration from philosophers like Marcus Aurelius, emphasizing gratitude and resilience.
prompts.usageInstructions: Replace [Name] and [Age] and paste into Claude or Gemini for the most poetic result.

prompts.title: Heartwarming Card for Mom
prompts.description: A deeply emotional appreciation message thanking your mother for her endless support.
prompts.text: Write a heartwarming, emotional birthday message for my mother. Focus on expressing gratitude for her unconditional love, her strength, and the quiet sacrifices she made while I was growing up. Mention how her [Insert quality, e.g., cooking/warm hugs] always represents home to me. The tone should be deeply loving, respectful, and emotional enough to bring a happy tear to her eye.
prompts.usageInstructions: Unlock this premium prompt by watching a short ad! Fits perfectly inside a physical card.

prompts.title: Sci-Fi Metaphor Love Letter
prompts.description: A highly creative, nerdy, and deeply romantic letter using astrophysics metaphors.
prompts.text: Write a creative and deeply romantic love letter for [Partner's Name]. Use astrophysics and space-time metaphors (e.g., gravitational pull, stars forming in nebulas, cosmic microwave background radiation) to describe how our souls are entangled across the universe. The tone should be elegant, nerdy yet deeply passionate, and highly poetic.
prompts.usageInstructions: Best used for anniversaries or Valentine's Day. Paste into Claude for maximum literary quality.

prompts.title: Sweet Daily Morning Text Writer
prompts.description: Short, cute, and deeply affectionate morning notes to make your partner smile.
prompts.text: Create a list of 5 unique, short, and sweet daily morning text messages to send to my partner. Each text should feel modern, authentic (no cheesy clichés), and express excitement about seeing them or appreciation for having them in my life. Use subtle cute emojis and keep them under 3 sentences.
prompts.usageInstructions: Select one of the 5 generated variations to send each morning!

prompts.title: Creative Storytelling Anniversary Speech
prompts.description: A beautiful narrative journey detailing how you met and how your love has evolved.
prompts.text: Write a deeply moving, story-driven anniversary speech for our [Number] year anniversary. Frame the speech like a movie script or a storybook, describing our journey from the moment we first met at [Place] to where we are today. Incorporate humor, highlight the small daily routines we share, and end with a beautiful toast to our future.
prompts.usageInstructions: Perfect for reading out loud during a dinner or gathering.

prompts.title: Warm Wedding Congratulations Writer
prompts.description: A highly personalized, elegant card message wishing a lifetime of joy to a newlywed couple.
prompts.text: Write a warm, elegant, and sincere wedding congratulations card for [Bride] and [Groom]. Focus on the beauty of their partnership, their shared commitment, and wish them a lifetime of shared laughter, resilience, and mutual growth. Maintain a premium, classic, and deeply respectful tone.
prompts.usageInstructions: Input the bride and groom names and paste into any major AI tool.

prompts.title: Assertive Salary Raise Request
prompts.description: A professional, bullet-proof script to negotiate a salary raise based on performance metrics.
prompts.text: Draft a highly professional, polite, yet firm email requesting a salary review/raise. I have been with the company for [Time] as a [Title]. Over the past year, my accomplishments include: [Insert accomplishment, e.g., increasing sales by 25%]. Frame the request around value delivered to the company and industry benchmarks, requesting a formal meeting to discuss my compensation packages.
prompts.usageInstructions: Add your specific metrics in the accomplishments bullet points for maximum impact.
variables: Insert accomplishment, e.g., increasing sales by 25%

prompts.title: Graceful Resignation Email Writer
prompts.description: A highly polished and respectful resignation letter that leaves the door open for future networking.
prompts.text: Write a graceful and professional resignation email for my role as [Job Title]. I am leaving to pursue [e.g., a new opportunity / career pivot]. Thank my manager [Manager Name] for their guidance, express gratitude for the positive culture of the team, and clearly state my last working day as [Date]. Offer a clear transition plan to train other team members before my departure.
prompts.usageInstructions: Unlock this premium prompt to exit your job with absolute class and strong references.
variables: e.g., a new opportunity / career pivot

prompts.title: Meeting Agenda & Objective Builder
prompts.description: Converts vague meeting ideas into a strict, goal-driven professional agenda.
prompts.text: Draft an organized, clear meeting agenda for a upcoming meeting regarding [Topic]. The meeting duration is [Time, e.g., 30 minutes]. Break down the agenda into clear time blocks (e.g., 5 min introduction, 15 min discussion, 10 min action items), define a clear core objective of the meeting, and list required pre-reading documents for attendees to read beforehand.
prompts.usageInstructions: Fill in the Topic and Time, and send the agenda to your team 24 hours before the meeting.

prompts.title: Sincere Best Friend Apology Letter
prompts.description: A vulnerable, non-defensive apology to heal a friendship after a major argument.
prompts.text: Compose a deeply sincere, non-defensive apology letter to my best friend [Friend Name] after our argument regarding [Topic]. Focus on taking full responsibility for my actions (e.g., overreacting / saying hurtful words), validate their feelings, and express how much I value their presence in my life. The letter must feel highly authentic, vulnerable, and invite them to talk whenever they are ready.
prompts.usageInstructions: Do not make excuses in the input. Let the AI write a healing, egoless apology.

prompts.title: Stoic Philosophical Morning Reminder
prompts.description: A deep, empowering morning self-talk reminder based on Stoic philosophy.
prompts.text: Write a powerful, stoic-inspired morning reflection to read before starting the day. Draw inspiration from Seneca and Marcus Aurelius. Focus on accepting things outside of my control, focusing 100% of my energy on my actions, treating obstacles as opportunities for growth, and starting the day with absolute mental clarity and resilience.
prompts.usageInstructions: Read this aloud every morning to build an unshakeable mindset.

prompts.title: Nostalgic Childhood Friend Check-In
prompts.description: A warm, affectionate text to reconnect with an old friend you haven't spoken to in years.
prompts.text: Write a warm, nostalgic, and pressure-free text message to send to an old childhood/high-school friend [Friend Name] whom I haven't seen in [Number] years. Mention a sweet memory we shared (e.g., our high school band / late-night drives), ask how their family is doing, and suggest a casual coffee catch-up without sounding demanding.
prompts.usageInstructions: Replace the memory placeholder and send via WhatsApp/text.

prompts.title: Viral Twitter/X Thread Blueprint
prompts.description: Crafts highly engaging hooks and structural layouts for viral informational threads.
prompts.text: Create a viral 5-tweet Twitter thread blueprint on the topic of [Insert Topic, e.g., how AI is changing coding]. Tweet 1 must be an attention-grabbing hook with high cognitive friction. Tweets 2-4 must provide highly valuable, actionable insights or bullet points. Tweet 5 must conclude with a strong Call-To-Action (CTA) encouraging retweets and follows.
prompts.usageInstructions: Input your core topic. Excellent for building your personal brand online.
variables: Insert Topic, e.g., how AI is changing coding

prompts.title: LinkedIn Storytelling Pitch Writer
prompts.description: Creates compelling, professional personal brand stories for the LinkedIn feed.
prompts.text: Draft a highly engaging, story-driven LinkedIn post about a career lesson I learned when [Describe a failure/event, e.g., my first startup failed]. Start with an impactful one-line hook, structure the body into short, readable sentences with clean spacing, detail the vulnerability of the struggle, and conclude with 3 actionable professional takeaways.
prompts.usageInstructions: Unlock this premium prompt to draft viral personal stories that boost your career network.
variables: Describe a failure/event, e.g., my first startup failed

prompts.title: High-Conversion Cold Pitch Email
prompts.description: A professional cold outreach email designed to secure meetings with high-profile clients.
prompts.text: Write a high-converting cold outreach email targeting [Target Client/Role]. I want to offer our [Service, e.g., mobile app design services]. The email must have an extremely short, intriguing subject line, establish instant credibility in 2 sentences, clearly explain the unique value proposition, provide a case-study metric [e.g., increased sales by 40%], and end with a low-friction CTA requesting a 10-minute calendar call.
prompts.usageInstructions: Replace client details and metrics for B2B client acquisition.
variables: Service, e.g., mobile app design services

prompts.title: Inclusive Corporate Holiday Wishes
prompts.description: Warm, festive, and highly inclusive holiday greetings appropriate for corporate teams.
prompts.text: Write a warm, inclusive, and professional holiday greetings email to send to my corporate team. Express deep gratitude for their hard work over the past year, celebrate our collective achievements, wish them a restful holiday season with their families, and keep the tone cheerful, professional, and culturally inclusive.
prompts.usageInstructions: Send to your department or company Slack channel before the holidays.

prompts.title: Hilarious Excuse for Being Late
prompts.description: Extremely creative, absurd, and funny excuses to send to friends when you run late.
prompts.text: Generate 3 hilarious and highly exaggerated excuses to send to my friends because I am running 15 minutes late to our hangout. Make the excuse sound like a movie plot (e.g., getting hijacked by a runaway squirrel / resolving a neighborhood cat dispute) while keeping it obvious that it is a sarcastic, friendly joke.
prompts.usageInstructions: Select the funniest option to break the ice before you arrive!

prompts.title: Blog Post Writer
prompts.description: Generate engaging blog posts on any topic with SEO optimization.
prompts.text: Write a blog post about [TOPIC] that is [LENGTH] words long, targeting the keyword [KEYWORD], with an engaging introduction, 3-4 main sections, and a compelling conclusion. Include practical tips and examples.
prompts.usageInstructions:
1. Replace [TOPIC] with your blog subject
2. Specify [LENGTH] (e.g., 1500 words)
3. Add main [KEYWORD] for SEO
4. Submit and refine as needed

prompts.title: Email Newsletter Creator
prompts.description: Create professional email newsletters with engaging subject lines.
prompts.text: Create a professional newsletter for [AUDIENCE] with subject line, preview text, 3 main content sections, and a call-to-action. Topic: [TOPIC]. Tone: [TONE].
prompts.usageInstructions:
1. Identify your [AUDIENCE]
2. Specify the main [TOPIC]
3. Choose [TONE] (professional, casual, friendly)
4. Copy the complete newsletter template

prompts.title: Python Code Optimizer
prompts.description: Refactor and optimize your Python code for performance and readability.
prompts.text: Review this Python function for potential performance bottlenecks, memory leaks, and readability issues: [CODE]. Provide the optimized code with comments explaining the refactoring decisions.
prompts.usageInstructions:
1. Paste your raw Python code in the [CODE] field.
2. Specify any performance targets (e.g. memory constraint).
3. Copy the clean optimized output.
prompts.exampleOutput:
def get_even(numbers):
    return [n for n in numbers if n % 2 == 0]  # Optimized with list comprehension

2. Paste code into your networking module.

prompts.text: Take my goal of [GOAL_DESC] in the area of Solo Traveling and convert it into 3 SMART goals. Break each goal down into Specific, Measurable, Actionable, Relevant, and Time-bound targets with weekly tasks.
prompts.usageInstructions:
1. Input your goal description.
2. Pin the output to your productivity board.
prompts.exampleOutput: Goal 1: Read 1 book per month. Specific: Read 15 mins daily. Measurable: Log on Goodreads. Time: 30 days.

prompts.title: Solo Traveling 30-Day Habit Blueprint
prompts.description: Build a sustainable 30-day habit loop checklist for Solo Traveling.
prompts.text: Design a 30-day habit blueprint for someone wanting to master [HABIT_NAME] to improve their Solo Traveling. Include a cue trigger, the routine details, a rewarding feedback loop, and a tracker outline.
prompts.usageInstructions:
1. Input the specific habit you want to start.
2. Print the tracker grid and mark daily boxes.
prompts.exampleOutput: Habit: 10-minute morning stretch. Cue: Coffee pot brewing. Routine: Dynamic stretching. Reward: Hot coffee.

prompts.title: Solo Traveling Motivation & Mindset Mentor
prompts.description: Get structured, encouraging advice to overcome bottlenecks in Solo Traveling.
prompts.text: Act as an empathetic life coach. I am struggling with [OBSTACLE] in my pursuit of Solo Traveling. Provide a 3-step reframing strategy, a list of actionable micro-tasks, and an encouraging closing statement.
prompts.usageInstructions:
1. Describe the mental blocks or challenges you face.
2. Read the coaching response whenever you feel stuck.
prompts.exampleOutput: Remember: progress is non-linear. Break down your task into 5-minute segments and start with just one.

prompts.title: Solo Traveling Actionable Priority Map
prompts.description: Design a 7-day calendar breakdown to align with Solo Traveling.
prompts.text: Create a weekly priority calendar map to align my schedule with my target in Solo Traveling. Focus on blocking time for [HIGH_PRIORITY_TASK], setting boundaries to avoid distractions, and leaving space for reflection.
prompts.usageInstructions:
1. Define the high priority task of the week.
2. Block the suggested calendar slots in Google Calendar.
prompts.exampleOutput: Monday: 9 AM - 11 AM: Deep work block on [Task]. Wednesday: 2 PM - 3 PM: Mid-week review.
