prompts.title: Honeymoon Packing List & Itinerary Template
prompts.description: A comprehensive honeymoon planning prompt.
prompts.text: Create a detailed honeymoon packing list and 7-day itinerary template for [Name1] and [Name2] travelling to [Destination]. Include romantic activities, must-try restaurants, packing essentials, and one surprise experience for Day 4.
prompts.usageInstructions: Customise destination and personal preferences.

prompts.title: Post-Wedding Thank-You Note Templates
prompts.description: Personalised thank-you note templates for wedding gifts.
prompts.text: Write 10 unique thank-you note templates for [Name1] and [Name2] to send after their wedding. Vary the tone: formal for distant relatives, warm for close friends, funny for colleagues. Each note should reference the specific gift type (cash, experience, physical item).
prompts.usageInstructions: Personalise each note with the recipient's name and specific gift.

prompts.title: Marriage Proposal Acceptance Post
prompts.description: A heartfelt social media post saying yes to a proposal.
prompts.text: Write an Instagram caption for [Name] announcing their engagement to [Partner Name]. The post should describe the emotion of the moment, include a playful detail about the proposal, and end with excitement about the future. Include 5 hashtag suggestions.
prompts.usageInstructions: Use with your engagement ring photo.

prompts.title: Weekly Team Stand-Up Agenda
prompts.description: A concise agenda template for daily or weekly stand-up meetings.
prompts.text: Write a structured 15-minute weekly stand-up meeting agenda for [Team Name]. Include sections: wins from last week, blockers, this week's priorities, and one open discussion topic. Keep it energetic and focused.
prompts.usageInstructions: Share via Slack or email before every Monday.

prompts.title: Board Meeting Executive Summary
prompts.description: A concise executive summary for board-level meetings.
prompts.text: Write a professional executive summary for the [Company] board meeting on [Date]. Summarise Q[X] financial performance, key strategic decisions made, risks identified, and the top 3 action items for next quarter. Language should be precise, authoritative, and data-forward.
prompts.usageInstructions: Unlock and share with board members 48 hours before the meeting.

prompts.title: Client Discovery Call Script
prompts.description: A warm, professional script for a first client call.
prompts.text: Write a client discovery call script for [Company/Freelancer] speaking with a potential client about [Service]. Include an opening introduction, 5 key discovery questions, a value proposition pitch, and a graceful close that proposes next steps.
prompts.usageInstructions: Practise this script 3 times before the actual call.

prompts.title: Meeting Cancellation Email
prompts.description: A professional but polite meeting cancellation email.
prompts.text: Write a professional email cancelling the meeting scheduled with [Recipient] on [Date/Time]. Give a sincere reason: [Reason]. Apologise for the inconvenience, propose two alternative times, and express genuine enthusiasm for rescheduling.
prompts.usageInstructions: Send at least 24 hours before the meeting.

prompts.title: Town Hall Announcement Email
prompts.description: Announce a company-wide town hall meeting with excitement.
prompts.text: Write an exciting company-wide email announcing the upcoming town hall meeting for [Company] on [Date] at [Time]. Outline the key agenda items: [Item1], [Item2], [Item3]. Encourage employees to submit anonymous questions in advance via [Link/Form].
prompts.usageInstructions: Send 5 business days before the town hall.

prompts.title: Investor Pitch Meeting Prep Talking Points
prompts.description: Key talking points to prepare for an investor pitch meeting.
prompts.text: Generate a comprehensive set of investor pitch meeting talking points for [Startup Name] in the [Industry] space. Cover: problem statement, solution, market size (TAM/SAM/SOM), business model, traction, team, and funding ask. Anticipate 5 tough investor questions and provide model answers.
prompts.usageInstructions: Unlock and review with your co-founder before the meeting.

prompts.title: Remote Meeting Icebreaker Questions
prompts.description: Fun icebreaker questions to open a remote team meeting.
prompts.text: Generate 10 creative and fun icebreaker questions for a remote team meeting for [Team Name]. Vary difficulty: some light (What's your morning drink?), some deeper (What skill are you learning this month?). Each question should be answerable in under 30 seconds.
prompts.usageInstructions: Ask one at the start of each meeting, rotating weekly.

prompts.title: Post-Meeting Action Items Email
prompts.description: A clean summary email listing decisions and action items after a meeting.
prompts.text: Write a post-meeting summary email for the [Meeting Name] held on [Date] with attendees [Names]. Summarise: decisions made, action items with owners and deadlines, open questions, and the next meeting date. Keep it under 200 words.
prompts.usageInstructions: Send within 1 hour of the meeting ending.

prompts.title: Performance Review Meeting Script
prompts.description: A structured manager script for a 1:1 performance review.
prompts.text: Write a structured performance review meeting script for [Manager Name] conducting a review with [Employee Name]. Cover: celebration of achievements, constructive feedback with specific examples, areas for growth, and collaborative goal-setting for the next quarter. Maintain a coaching, not evaluating, tone.
prompts.usageInstructions: Customise with specific performance data before the meeting.

prompts.title: Brainstorming Session Facilitator Script
prompts.description: A facilitator guide for a creative brainstorm session.
prompts.text: Write a 60-minute brainstorming session facilitator guide for [Team] on the topic of [Topic]. Include a warm-up exercise, three structured ideation rounds (mind mapping, crazy 8s, dot voting), and a debrief format. Include facilitation tips for managing dominant voices.
prompts.usageInstructions: Print and follow during the session.

prompts.title: Difficult Conversation Meeting Script
prompts.description: Navigate a tough conversation with a colleague or manager.
prompts.text: Write a step-by-step script for navigating a difficult conversation with [Person] about [Issue]. Use the SBI (Situation-Behaviour-Impact) framework. Include an opening that establishes psychological safety, specific observations without accusations, the impact on the team/project, and a collaborative close with proposed solutions.
prompts.usageInstructions: Unlock and practise this script before the actual meeting.

prompts.title: New Hire Onboarding Meeting Welcome Script
prompts.description: A warm welcome script for a new employee's first meeting.
prompts.text: Write a warm, structured welcome script for [Manager Name] introducing [New Employee Name] to the team at their first team meeting. Cover: quick personal intro, team introductions, first week schedule, who to go to for what, and an encouraging close.
prompts.usageInstructions: Pair with a welcome pack and a buddy assignment.

prompts.title: Sales Pipeline Review Meeting Agenda
prompts.description: A structured agenda for reviewing the sales pipeline.
prompts.text: Create a 45-minute sales pipeline review meeting agenda for [Sales Team]. Include: pipeline metrics overview (number of deals, stage distribution, velocity), deal deep-dives for top 5 opportunities, forecast accuracy review, blockers and support needed, and next actions. Allocate time per section.
prompts.usageInstructions: Share 24 hours before the meeting with current pipeline data attached.

prompts.title: Retrospective Meeting Facilitation Guide
prompts.description: A structured retro guide for agile teams.
prompts.text: Write a sprint retrospective meeting guide for [Team] using the "Start, Stop, Continue" format. Include a warm-up activity, rules of engagement, timed rounds for each section, dot voting for prioritisation, and a commitment capture at the close. Duration: 60 minutes.
prompts.usageInstructions: Rotate who facilitates the retro each sprint.

prompts.title: Stakeholder Update Meeting Deck Outline
prompts.description: Slide-by-slide outline for a stakeholder update presentation.
prompts.text: Create a slide-by-slide outline for a 20-minute stakeholder update presentation for project [Project Name]. Slides to include: executive summary, progress vs milestones, risks and mitigations, budget status, key decisions needed from stakeholders, and next steps. For each slide, specify the key message and supporting data point.
prompts.usageInstructions: Build the deck from this outline in Google Slides or PowerPoint.

prompts.title: Virtual Coffee Chat Conversation Guide
prompts.description: Break the ice on a virtual 1:1 coffee chat.
prompts.text: Write a structured conversation guide for a 30-minute virtual coffee chat with [Name] from [Company/Team]. Include: a warm opener, 5 light conversation topics, 3 professional curiosity questions, and a graceful close that plants a seed for future collaboration.
prompts.usageInstructions: Keep this on a second screen during the call.

prompts.title: Crisis Management Emergency Meeting Script
prompts.description: A rapid-response meeting script for managing a crisis.
prompts.text: Write an emergency crisis management meeting script for [Company] leadership responding to [Crisis Situation]. Structure: situation assessment (what do we know?), immediate containment actions, communication plan (internal and external), accountability assignments, and 24-hour check-in schedule. Keep language calm, decisive, and clear.
prompts.usageInstructions: Unlock and keep on file for emergency preparedness.

prompts.title: Partnership Exploration Meeting Agenda
prompts.description: An agenda for exploring a potential business partnership.
prompts.text: Write a 60-minute partnership exploration meeting agenda for [Company A] and [Company B]. Include: company introductions, vision alignment check, complementary capability mapping, potential collaboration model brainstorm, concerns and questions, and agreed next steps.
prompts.usageInstructions: Share with the other party 48 hours before the meeting.

prompts.title: Department Budget Meeting Preparation Guide
prompts.description: Prepare for a budget review with clarity and confidence.
prompts.text: Create a preparation guide for [Manager Name] attending a department budget review meeting. Include: the 5 must-have data points to present, how to defend budget requests with ROI language, how to respond to cut requests gracefully, and the 3 questions to ask leadership during the meeting.
prompts.usageInstructions: Review this guide 48 hours before your budget meeting.

prompts.title: Mentor-Mentee Meeting Structure Guide
prompts.description: A productive monthly mentor-mentee meeting format.
prompts.text: Write a structured guide for a monthly 45-minute mentor-mentee meeting between [Mentor Name] and [Mentee Name]. Include: wins celebration, challenges discussion, skill-focus deep dive, resource sharing, and action commitments. Provide 5 recurring discussion questions to keep conversations deep.
prompts.usageInstructions: Use as your standing meeting template for the whole mentorship programme.

prompts.title: Heartfelt Apology to a Partner
prompts.description: A sincere, non-defensive apology for a relationship conflict.
prompts.text: Write a heartfelt apology message to my partner [Name] for [Specific Action]. Acknowledge exactly what I did wrong without deflecting blame. Explain how it must have felt from their perspective, express genuine remorse, and outline what I will specifically change going forward. Avoid the word "but".
prompts.usageInstructions: Send as a text or read aloud to your partner.

prompts.title: Apology to a Best Friend After a Fight
prompts.description: Reconnect with your best friend after a falling out.
prompts.text: Write a casual but deeply sincere apology message to my best friend [Name] after our argument about [Topic]. Acknowledge my role, affirm how much the friendship means to me, and end with a light-hearted proposal to meet up and make things right.
prompts.usageInstructions: Send via WhatsApp or as a voice message.

prompts.title: Professional Apology for Missing a Deadline
prompts.description: A professional apology email for a missed work deadline.
prompts.text: Write a professional apology email to [Manager/Client] for missing the deadline for [Project/Task]. Take full accountability, briefly explain what caused the delay, provide a revised timeline, and outline steps to prevent recurrence. Keep it concise and confident.
prompts.usageInstructions: Send immediately once you know the deadline is missed.

prompts.title: Public Apology Statement for a Mistake
prompts.description: A structured public apology statement for social media or press.
prompts.text: Write a public apology statement for [Person/Brand] regarding [Incident]. Follow the STAR apology framework: Situation (acknowledge what happened), Take responsibility (no excuses), Acknowledge impact (on those affected), and Rectify (concrete steps taken). Avoid corporate language—be human.
prompts.usageInstructions: Review with a PR professional before posting.

prompts.title: Apology Letter to a Family Member
prompts.description: Mend a family relationship with a sincere letter.
prompts.text: Write an apology letter to my [Family Member, e.g., sister] for [Specific Mistake]. Acknowledge the pain caused, take full responsibility, share what I wish I had done differently, and express hope for healing the relationship. Tone: humble, warm, and patient.
prompts.usageInstructions: Handwrite for maximum sincerity.

prompts.title: Apology Gift Note
prompts.description: A short note accompanying an apology gift.
prompts.text: Write a short, sincere apology note (4-6 sentences) to attach to a gift for [Name]. Acknowledge the specific wrong, explain that the gift is a small symbol of your remorse, and invite them to talk when they're ready. Keep it non-pressuring.
prompts.usageInstructions: Hand-write and attach to the gift.

prompts.title: Apology to a Customer for Poor Service
prompts.description: A professional customer service apology email.
prompts.text: Write a customer service apology email from [Company] to [Customer Name] regarding their complaint about [Issue]. Acknowledge their frustration empathetically, explain what happened, describe the resolution steps taken, offer a goodwill gesture (e.g., discount/refund), and thank them for their patience.
prompts.usageInstructions: Send within 24 hours of receiving the complaint.

prompts.title: Late-Night Apology Text
prompts.description: A raw, midnight apology text when you can't sleep.
prompts.text: Write a short, raw, late-night apology text to [Name] for [Incident]. It should feel honest and personal—not rehearsed. Express that I've been thinking about it and couldn't sleep. Don't demand a response; give them space.
prompts.usageInstructions: Only send if you've given them space for at least a few hours first.

prompts.title: Apology for Forgetting an Important Date
prompts.description: Make up for forgetting a birthday or anniversary.
prompts.text: Write a warm, genuinely remorseful message to [Name] apologising for forgetting their [birthday/anniversary/important date] on [Date]. Acknowledge how thoughtless it must have felt, express real shame, and propose a way to celebrate belatedly.
prompts.usageInstructions: Pair with a surprise plan to make it up to them.

prompts.title: Apology for Social Media Miscommunication
prompts.description: Clarify and apologise for an offensive social media post.
prompts.text: Write a social media apology post for [Name/Brand] clarifying a misunderstood or offensive [Post/Comment/Story] made on [Date]. Acknowledge why it was harmful, take responsibility without over-explaining, and state the corrective understanding. Use first-person, not passive voice.
prompts.usageInstructions: Post as a story and a pinned comment.

prompts.title: Apology to a Teacher or Mentor
prompts.description: A respectful apology to an authority figure.
prompts.text: Write a respectful apology note to [Teacher/Mentor Name] for [Behaviour, e.g., missing class/being disrespectful/not submitting work on time]. Acknowledge the disrespect, explain context briefly, and express a genuine commitment to doing better.
prompts.usageInstructions: Hand-deliver or email at the start of the next session.
variables: Behaviour, e.g., missing class/being disrespectful/not submitting work on time

prompts.title: Apology for Ghosting Someone
prompts.description: Acknowledge and apologise for disappearing without explanation.
prompts.text: Write an honest apology message to [Name] for going silent (ghosting) after [Context, e.g., dating/close friendship]. Acknowledge the hurt caused, take full responsibility, give a brief honest reason without making excuses, and leave them with closure—not an opening for argument.
prompts.usageInstructions: Send, then respect whatever response (or silence) they choose.

prompts.title: Apology in a Different Language (Template)
prompts.description: Culturally sensitive apology for a cross-cultural relationship.
prompts.text: Write an apology message to [Name] from [Cultural Background] for [Mistake]. Acknowledge any cultural insensitivity involved, express respect for their values, and offer to learn more. Provide the apology in both English and [Language] side by side.
prompts.usageInstructions: Have a native speaker review the translation before sending.

prompts.title: Self-Compassion Apology to Yourself
prompts.description: A guided self-forgiveness message for personal mistakes.
prompts.text: Write a self-compassion letter from me to myself, apologising for [Mistake/Harsh Judgement]. Use Dr. Kristin Neff's self-compassion framework: mindfulness (acknowledge the pain), common humanity (I'm not alone in this), and self-kindness (what would I say to a friend?). End with a compassionate commitment to myself.
prompts.usageInstructions: Unlock and journal this privately during a quiet moment.

prompts.title: Apology via Poem
prompts.description: Express your apology through the art of poetry.
prompts.text: Write a 4-stanza apology poem for [Name] about [Incident]. First stanza: describe the moment the mistake happened. Second stanza: sit in the guilt and regret. Third stanza: a genuine ask for forgiveness. Fourth stanza: a promise and a vision of healing. Use accessible but heartfelt language.
prompts.usageInstructions: Unlock, handwrite, and deliver personally.

prompts.title: Apology Speech for a Group or Team
prompts.description: Apologise to a team or group for a leadership mistake.
prompts.text: Write a brief apology speech for [Leader Name] to deliver to their team about [Mistake, e.g., poor communication/unfair decision]. Acknowledge the impact on team morale, take responsibility without shifting blame, share what's changing, and end with a sincere thank-you for the team's patience.
prompts.usageInstructions: Deliver at the next team meeting without reading from a script.

prompts.title: Apology for an Argument via Voice Note Script
prompts.description: What to say in an apology voice message.
prompts.text: Write a 60-second apology voice note script for [Name] after our argument about [Topic]. Sound genuine, not rehearsed. Open with acknowledging the tension, say what I did wrong in specific terms, express how I feel, and invite them to talk when they're ready—without pressure.
prompts.usageInstructions: Record naturally—it's okay if your voice cracks a little.

prompts.title: Apology to a Child for a Parent's Mistake
prompts.description: An age-appropriate apology from a parent to their child.
prompts.text: Write an age-appropriate apology from a parent to their [Age]-year-old child for [Mistake, e.g., losing temper/breaking a promise]. Use simple, warm language the child can understand. Model accountability, show emotional vulnerability, and end with a hug-worthy promise.
prompts.usageInstructions: Say this aloud to your child rather than reading it to them.
variables: Mistake, e.g., losing temper/breaking a promise

prompts.title: Apology Note for a Neighbourhood Dispute
prompts.description: Resolve a local conflict with a calm, sincere note.
prompts.text: Write a polite, sincere apology note to my neighbour [Name] for [Incident, e.g., noise/parking/pet issue]. Acknowledge the inconvenience caused, offer a resolution, and express a genuine desire to maintain a good neighbourly relationship. Keep it brief and warm.
prompts.usageInstructions: Place in their letterbox or hand-deliver.

prompts.title: Recurring Mistake Apology — Breaking the Pattern
prompts.description: An apology that also commits to genuine behavioural change.
prompts.text: Write a deeply honest apology to [Name] for repeating the same mistake of [Behaviour] for the [Number] time. Acknowledge that words without change are empty. Share a specific, concrete accountability plan (e.g., therapy, journalling, communication rules) that proves this time is different. Do not ask for immediate forgiveness—only commit to action.
prompts.usageInstructions: Unlock, share this, and immediately follow through on the actions described.

prompts.title: Kids Birthday Invitation Wording
prompts.description: Playful birthday party invitation for a child's party.
prompts.text: Write a fun, rhyming birthday party invitation for [Child Name]'s [Age]-year birthday party on [Date] at [Venue/Time]. Theme: [Theme, e.g., Dinosaurs/Unicorns/Superheroes]. Include RSVP details and a playful dress code note.
prompts.usageInstructions: Design and print for party guests.

prompts.title: Milestone 30th Birthday Speech
prompts.description: A celebratory speech marking someone's 30th birthday.
prompts.text: Write a warm, funny, and reflective speech for [Name]'s 30th birthday celebration. Cover: the journey of their 20s (highs and embarrassing lows), the qualities that make them exceptional, and a heartfelt toast to the decade ahead. Duration: ~4 minutes.
prompts.usageInstructions: Deliver at the birthday dinner or party.

prompts.title: Birthday Poem for a Grandparent
prompts.description: A loving poem celebrating a grandparent's birthday.
prompts.text: Write a warm, four-stanza birthday poem for my [grandmother/grandfather] [Name] turning [Age]. Each stanza should celebrate a different quality: their wisdom, their stories, their warmth, and their legacy. Use accessible, emotional language.
prompts.usageInstructions: Frame and gift alongside their favourite sweet.

prompts.title: Surprise Party Planning Announcement
prompts.description: Build excitement for a surprise birthday party.
prompts.text: Write a surprise birthday party planning invitation to send to [Friend/Family]'s inner circle for [Birthday Person Name]'s surprise party on [Date]. Include: the cover story to get them there, what to bring, where to park, and the "SHHHH!" instructions.
prompts.usageInstructions: Send via group chat, ensuring the birthday person is not in it.

prompts.title: Birthday Letter — From Parent to Child on 18th
prompts.description: A milestone letter from a parent to their newly adult child.
prompts.text: Write a profound letter from a parent to their child [Name] on their 18th birthday. Reflect on watching them grow from infant to adult. Share the fears, pride, and awe of parenting. Give them three core life principles to carry forward. End with an unconditional love declaration. This letter is a keepsake.
prompts.usageInstructions: Unlock, handwrite, and present as an 18th birthday gift.

prompts.title: Celebrity Birthday Shoutout Style Post
prompts.description: Write a birthday post in the style of a celebrity shoutout.
prompts.text: Write a birthday Instagram post for [Name] in the style of a celebrity fan shoutout. Include hype, heartfelt compliments, inside references, and end with a call-to-action for followers to wish them well. Add a hashtag pack.
prompts.usageInstructions: Post on your social media and tag the birthday person.

prompts.title: Birthday Bucket List Generator
prompts.description: A personalised birthday bucket list for the year ahead.
prompts.text: Create a personalised [Age]-item birthday bucket list for [Name] as they turn [Age]. Include a mix of: adventurous experiences, creative pursuits, personal growth challenges, social connections, and small daily joys. Match the energy and interests of [Name] based on: [Brief description of their personality].
prompts.usageInstructions: Print and gift as a birthday card alternative.

prompts.title: 40th Birthday Roast Comedy Set
prompts.description: A structured comedy roast set for a 40th birthday party.
prompts.text: Write a 5-minute roast comedy set for [Name]'s 40th birthday party. Structure: opening self-deprecating bit, 3 roast targets (age, specific habits like [Habit1] and [Habit2], career), a sentimental pivot, and a heartfelt closing toast. Punch lines should land and not actually hurt.
prompts.usageInstructions: Unlock and practise the delivery—timing is everything.

prompts.title: Virtual Birthday Party Game Script
prompts.description: Games and activities for a virtual birthday celebration.
prompts.text: Design a 1-hour virtual birthday party programme for [Name] on Zoom with [Number] guests. Include: a themed icebreaker, 2 games (e.g., trivia about the birthday person, online Pictionary), a virtual cake ceremony moment, and a shared playlist prompt. Provide the host script.
prompts.usageInstructions: Share game links and rules with guests 24 hours before.

prompts.title: Birthday Wish from a Pet (Humorous)
prompts.description: A funny birthday message written from the perspective of a pet.
prompts.text: Write a hilarious birthday message to [Owner Name] from the perspective of their pet [Pet Name] (a [Dog/Cat/Hamster]). The pet should take credit for being the best birthday gift ever, complain about unfair treat distribution, and reluctantly admit their deep love for their owner.
prompts.usageInstructions: Print on a card with a photo of the pet.

prompts.title: Birthday Thank You Note Template
prompts.description: Thoughtful thank-you notes for birthday gifts.
prompts.text: Write 8 unique birthday thank-you note templates for [Name] to use after their birthday. For each, vary the relationship (close friend, colleague, grandparent, child's school friend) and the gift type (experience, cash, physical gift). Keep each note under 50 words and genuine.
prompts.usageInstructions: Personalise and send within 1 week of the birthday.

prompts.title: Astrology Birthday Horoscope Message
prompts.description: A personalised birthday message based on astrology.
prompts.text: Write a personalised birthday horoscope message for [Name] born on [Date], making them a [Zodiac Sign]. Blend real astrological traits of [Sign] with personalised wishes for their year ahead. Include a fun "cosmic challenge" and a "this year's lucky charm". Keep it fun and believable.
prompts.usageInstructions: Add their birth time for extra detail if known.

prompts.title: Birthday Morning Breakfast Note
prompts.description: A sweet note left for a birthday morning surprise.
prompts.text: Write a short, warm birthday morning note to leave beside the coffee/breakfast for [Partner/Child/Friend Name] on their birthday. Keep it 4-6 sentences: express joy at celebrating them, mention one reason they're exceptional, and preview a surprise you've planned for later.
prompts.usageInstructions: Leave it where they'll find it first thing in the morning.

prompts.title: Office Birthday Announcement Email
prompts.description: An energetic email announcing a colleague's birthday.
prompts.text: Write a fun, upbeat office announcement email celebrating [Colleague Name]'s birthday today. Include a fun fact or achievement about them, a heads-up about the cake in the break room, and an invitation for the team to sign a digital greeting card via [Link]. Keep it short and celebratory.
prompts.usageInstructions: Send on the morning of their birthday.

prompts.title: Philosophical Birthday Reflection Prompt
prompts.description: A thoughtful prompt for personal birthday reflection.
prompts.text: Write a set of 10 deep birthday reflection journal prompts for [Name] turning [Age]. Cover: what this past year taught you, who you've become, relationships gained and lost, regrets to release, intentions for the year ahead, and one word to define the new chapter.
prompts.usageInstructions: Gift with a beautiful journal for their birthday.

prompts.title: LinkedIn Profile Headline Optimizer
prompts.description: Craft a magnetic LinkedIn headline for your dream job.
prompts.text: Write 5 alternative LinkedIn profile headlines for [Name] who works as a [Current Title] with expertise in [Skill1], [Skill2], and [Skill3], targeting roles in [Target Industry]. Each headline should be under 220 characters and lead with value, not just a job title.
prompts.usageInstructions: A/B test the top 2 and track profile views for 2 weeks.

prompts.title: Cover Letter for First Job (Fresher)
prompts.description: A compelling cover letter for a recent graduate with no experience.
prompts.text: Write a confident, genuine cover letter for [Name], a [Degree] graduate from [University] applying for the role of [Job Title] at [Company]. They have no formal experience but bring [Transferable Skill1], [Transferable Skill2] from university projects and volunteering. Tone: enthusiastic, humble, and professional.
prompts.usageInstructions: Customise with a specific achievement from university.

prompts.title: STAR Method Interview Answer Generator
prompts.description: Prepare strong behavioural interview answers using STAR.
prompts.text: Help me write a STAR-method interview answer for the question "Tell me about a time you [Situation, e.g., led a team through a crisis]." My situation: [My Story]. Structure my answer into Situation, Task, Action, and Result, with the Result including a measurable outcome.
prompts.usageInstructions: Practice this answer aloud 5 times before your interview.
variables: Situation, e.g., led a team through a crisis

prompts.title: Resignation Letter — Professional & Gracious
prompts.description: A dignified resignation letter that protects your reputation.
prompts.text: Write a professional resignation letter for [Name] leaving the position of [Job Title] at [Company]. Notice period: [Weeks]. Include: a gracious thank-you for the opportunity, brief mention of what you've learned, an offer to help during the transition, and an optimistic close.
prompts.usageInstructions: Submit to HR and your direct manager simultaneously.

prompts.title: Job Rejection Graceful Response
prompts.description: Respond to a job rejection professionally to preserve the relationship.
prompts.text: Write a gracious reply email to a job rejection from [Company] for the [Job Title] role. Thank them for the opportunity and their time, express continued admiration for the company, ask for feedback on your application if possible, and express hope to apply for future roles.
prompts.usageInstructions: Send within 48 hours of the rejection email.

prompts.title: Cold Email for Job Opportunity
prompts.description: A non-applicant cold email that creates interview opportunities.
prompts.text: Write a compelling cold email from [Name] ([Background]) to [Decision Maker Name] at [Company]. Purpose: to introduce yourself and explore unadvertised opportunities in [Department]. Research-driven personalisation: reference [Specific Company Initiative or Achievement]. Close with a low-friction ask (15-minute call).
prompts.usageInstructions: Unlock and personalise for each company before sending.

prompts.title: Freelance Portfolio Bio
prompts.description: A compelling "About Me" bio for a freelance portfolio.
prompts.text: Write a first-person "About Me" portfolio bio for freelancer [Name] who specialises in [Specialty]. They have [X] years of experience, have worked with clients like [Client Type], and bring a unique approach of [Unique Value]. Provide a short version (50 words) and long version (150 words).
prompts.usageInstructions: Use the short version on social bios and the long version on your website.

prompts.title: Thank-You Email After an Interview
prompts.description: A strategic post-interview thank-you email.
prompts.text: Write a post-interview thank-you email for [Name] after interviewing for [Job Title] at [Company] with [Interviewer Name]. Reference a specific moment from the conversation about [Topic Discussed], reaffirm your top strength for the role, and express genuine enthusiasm for next steps.
prompts.usageInstructions: Send within 2 hours of leaving the interview.

prompts.title: Promotion Justification Memo
prompts.description: Make a compelling written case for your promotion.
prompts.text: Write a self-advocacy memo for [Name] requesting promotion from [Current Title] to [Target Title] at [Company]. Structure: current responsibilities exceeded, key achievements with metrics ([Achievement1 + KPI], [Achievement2 + KPI]), industry comparison of compensation, and the value I would add in the new role.
prompts.usageInstructions: Unlock and present to your manager alongside your next performance review.

prompts.title: Internship Application Email
prompts.description: An enthusiastic internship application email for students.
prompts.text: Write an internship application email for [Student Name] studying [Degree] at [University] applying for the [Internship Title] at [Company]. Highlight: passion for [Industry], a relevant project or coursework, and specific skills ([Skill1], [Skill2]). Keep it under 200 words and include a CV attachment note.
prompts.usageInstructions: Attach your CV and apply as soon as the listing goes live.

prompts.title: Job Reference Request Email
prompts.description: A polite email requesting a professional reference.
prompts.text: Write a professional email from [Name] to their former manager [Reference Name] at [Company], requesting a reference for the [Job Title] role at [New Company]. Include: context on the role, why they'd be the ideal reference, key talking points to highlight, and an easy opt-out option.
prompts.usageInstructions: Give your reference at least 2 weeks' notice.

prompts.title: Career Change Cover Letter
prompts.description: Navigate a career pivot with a strategic cover letter.
prompts.text: Write a career change cover letter for [Name] transitioning from [Previous Industry] to [New Industry] for the role of [Job Title] at [Company]. Lead with transferable skills, pre-empt the "why the change?" question, and reframe previous experience as an asset, not a liability.
prompts.usageInstructions: Pair with a strong LinkedIn update and skill endorsements.

prompts.title: Job Interview "Tell Me About Yourself" Script
prompts.description: A polished 90-second career narrative for interviews.
prompts.text: Write a 90-second "Tell Me About Yourself" script for [Name] applying for [Job Title] at [Company]. Structure: where I started, key career milestones, what I bring, and why this role/company now. Make it conversational, memorable, and tailored to [Industry].
prompts.usageInstructions: Practise until it sounds natural, not memorised.

prompts.title: Networking Follow-Up After an Event
prompts.description: A strategic follow-up message after a networking event.
prompts.text: Write a follow-up message to [Contact Name] met at [Event Name] on [Date]. Reference the specific topic we discussed (e.g., [Topic]), reinforce your shared interest, offer a relevant resource or insight, and propose a 15-minute call to continue the conversation.
prompts.usageInstructions: Send within 24 hours of the event.

prompts.title: Remote Work Application Cover Letter
prompts.description: Specifically optimised for remote job applications.
prompts.text: Write a remote job cover letter for [Name] applying for the [Remote Job Title] role at [Company]. Highlight remote-work superpowers: async communication, self-discipline, home office setup, and time zone adaptability. Reference a previous remote achievement with a measurable outcome.
prompts.usageInstructions: Include your time zone and UTC offset prominently.

prompts.title: Eid Mubarak Family Message
prompts.description: A warm, spiritual Eid greeting for family and friends.
prompts.text: Write a warm Eid Mubarak message for family and close friends. Include references to the joy of Eid prayers, the fragrance of new clothes and biryani, gratitude for blessings, and a heartfelt dua for peace, health, and happiness. Offer three variations: formal, casual, and one for a group WhatsApp.
prompts.usageInstructions: Use the group version for your family and friends WhatsApp group.

prompts.title: Diwali Corporate Greeting Email
prompts.description: A professionally warm Diwali email for corporate clients.
prompts.text: Write a formal but warm Diwali greeting email from [Company Name] to their clients and partners. Reference the themes of light overcoming darkness as a business metaphor, express gratitude for the year's collaboration, and wish them a prosperous new year. Sign off with a leadership name.
prompts.usageInstructions: Send 2 days before Diwali for maximum impact.

prompts.title: Christmas Letter to a Loved One Abroad
prompts.description: A warm, nostalgic Christmas letter for someone far away.
prompts.text: Write a warm Christmas letter to [Name] living abroad, from [Writer Name]. Capture the sensory memories of a shared childhood Christmas (smells, sounds, traditions), express how much they are missed, share a family update, and end with wishes for the new year and a promise to visit.
prompts.usageInstructions: Post the physical letter in early December for guaranteed delivery.

prompts.title: Holi Colour Festival Social Media Post
prompts.description: A vibrant, joyful social media post for Holi.
prompts.text: Write 3 Holi festival social media captions—one playful and colourful, one poetic using metaphors of colour as emotion, and one with cultural depth about the mythology of Holi. Include emoji packs and relevant hashtags for each.
prompts.usageInstructions: Schedule for Holi morning across Instagram, WhatsApp status, and Twitter.

prompts.title: New Year Resolution Commitment Letter
prompts.description: A powerful personal commitment letter for the New Year.
prompts.text: Write a personal New Year commitment letter from [Name] to themselves. Review the past year with honest compassion, identify the top 3 patterns to break, set 3 specific, measurable intentions for the year ahead, and create a 30-60-90 day check-in structure. End with a motivating personal manifesto.
prompts.usageInstructions: Unlock, print, and review on 31st January, 28th February, and 31st March.

prompts.title: Navratri Garba Night Invitation
prompts.description: A festive invitation for a Navratri Garba event.
prompts.text: Write a vibrant invitation for a Navratri Garba night on [Date] at [Venue]. Include the theme colour for each night if applicable, traditional dress code (chaniya choli/kurta), timings, and a fun line about the garba DJ and prasad. Keep the spirit lively and welcoming.
prompts.usageInstructions: Share on WhatsApp and Instagram 10 days before the event.

prompts.title: Ramadan Reflection Journal Prompts
prompts.description: 30 daily reflection prompts for the holy month of Ramadan.
prompts.text: Create 30 daily Ramadan reflection journal prompts for [Name]. Cover spiritual growth (gratitude, forgiveness, intention), community (acts of charity, connection with family), physical discipline (fasting reflections, mindful iftar), and forward planning for after Ramadan. Prompts should be concise but deep.
prompts.usageInstructions: Print or save digitally and complete one each day of Ramadan.

prompts.title: Christmas Wish List for Gifting
prompts.description: Help craft the perfect Christmas gift wish list.
prompts.text: Create a structured Christmas wish list for [Name] with a budget guide. Include 3 tiers: under [Budget1] (stocking stuffers), [Budget1]-[Budget2] (main gifts), above [Budget2] (dream gifts). For each tier, suggest 5 items matched to [Name]'s interests in [Hobby1], [Hobby2], and [Hobby3].
prompts.usageInstructions: Share with family 4 weeks before Christmas.

prompts.title: Easter Sunday Family Message
prompts.description: A warm Easter greeting with spiritual and family themes.
prompts.text: Write an Easter Sunday message for [Name]'s family group chat. Reference the themes of renewal, hope, and spring. Include a warm invite to the family Easter lunch, mention the egg hunt for the children, and end with a short prayer of gratitude. Provide a Christian version and a secular version.
prompts.usageInstructions: Send on Easter Sunday morning.

prompts.title: Janmashtami Temple Program Flyer Copy
prompts.description: Event copy for a Janmashtami temple celebration.
prompts.text: Write the event copy for a Janmashtami celebration at [Temple/Community Name] on [Date]. Include: programme timings (bhajans, midnight aarti, bhog prasad distribution), dress code, parking info, and a devotional invitation paragraph describing the significance of Janmashtami.
prompts.usageInstructions: Print on A5 flyers and distribute at the temple entrance.

prompts.title: Thanksgiving Dinner Toast
prompts.description: A warm, reflective toast for the Thanksgiving table.
prompts.text: Write a warm Thanksgiving dinner toast for [Host Name] to deliver before the meal. Acknowledge the year's challenges and blessings, name a few specific things the family is grateful for, raise a glass to the people present and those absent, and close with a traditional blessing.
prompts.usageInstructions: Memorise or read naturally from your phone.

prompts.title: Dussehra Message — Good Over Evil Reflection
prompts.description: A thoughtful Dussehra message with modern relevance.
prompts.text: Write a Dussehra reflection message for [Name] to share on WhatsApp or Instagram. Beyond the burning of Ravana, apply the symbolism to modern "evils" we burn each year—self-doubt, toxic habits, fear. Invite others to share what they are symbolically burning this Dussehra.
prompts.usageInstructions: Post as a story with a poll for followers to respond.

prompts.title: Lunar New Year Red Envelope Message
prompts.description: Traditional and modern messages for red envelopes.
prompts.text: Write 5 Lunar New Year red envelope (hongbao) blessing messages for [Year/Zodiac Animal]. Include: one for elders (respectful), one for children (playful), one for business partners (professional), one for close friends (warm), and one poetic verse. Provide both English and Mandarin side by side.
prompts.usageInstructions: Have a native Mandarin speaker review the translation.

prompts.title: Vesak Day Reflection Message
prompts.description: A mindful Vesak message celebrating the Buddha's teachings.
prompts.text: Write a thoughtful Vesak Day reflection post for [Name]. Draw on the three core Buddhist teachings (Impermanence, Non-self, Suffering and its end) and apply them to one personal experience from the past year. End with a wish for universal compassion and peace.
prompts.usageInstructions: Share on social media or in a personal journal.

prompts.title: Pongal Festival Celebration Post
prompts.description: A vibrant Pongal harvest festival message.
prompts.text: Write a joyful Pongal festival greeting post for social media. Reference the four days of Pongal (Bhogi Pongal, Surya Pongal, Maattu Pongal, Kanum Pongal), the boiling of the sacred rice pot, and the thanks given to the Sun God. Provide Tamil and English versions.
prompts.usageInstructions: Post on the morning of Surya Pongal (Day 2).

prompts.title: Reply to "I Miss You" — Poetic Version
prompts.description: A beautiful poetic reply to a missing-you message.
prompts.text: Write a poetic, heartfelt reply to receiving the message "I miss you" from [Partner Name]. Use a nature metaphor (e.g., moon, tide, seasons) to express that the feeling is mutual and constant. Keep it 4-6 sentences and deeply personal.
prompts.usageInstructions: Copy and personalise with a specific shared memory.

prompts.title: Reply to a Good Morning Message
prompts.description: A warm, creative reply to a partner's good morning text.
prompts.text: Write 5 unique replies to a "Good morning, beautiful/handsome" text from [Partner Name]. Vary the tones: one sleepy and cute, one playful, one deeply loving, one with a compliment back, and one that sets an exciting intention for the day together.
prompts.usageInstructions: Save your favourite and use it tomorrow morning.

prompts.title: Reply to "I Love You" — First Time Said
prompts.description: The perfect reply when someone says I love you first.
prompts.text: Write a genuine, non-awkward reply to [Partner Name] saying "I love you" for the first time. Options: one reply where you feel the same and express it beautifully, one honest reply if you're not ready yet but care deeply, and one playful deflection that still conveys warmth.
prompts.usageInstructions: Unlock and choose the reply that matches your true emotional state.

prompts.title: Reply to a Sad Message from Partner
prompts.description: Comfort your partner when they're having a hard day.
prompts.text: Write a warm, validating reply to [Partner Name] who just texted that they are having a terrible day. Don't minimise their feelings—acknowledge them. Offer presence (not advice unless asked), suggest something small you can do (a call, a delivery, a voice note), and end with an affirmation of your support.
prompts.usageInstructions: Send immediately, then follow up with the action.

prompts.title: Flirty Banter Reply Pack
prompts.description: Playful, witty replies to keep the spark alive.
prompts.text: Generate 8 witty, flirtatious banter replies to playful messages from [Partner Name]. Include replies that tease gently, compliment cleverly, issue playful challenges, and end conversations on a high note. Match the energy: Gen-Z casual meets timeless charm.
prompts.usageInstructions: Save these and deploy them when the conversation needs a spark.

prompts.title: Reply to a Long Romantic Letter
prompts.description: Respond to a heartfelt love letter with equal depth.
prompts.text: Write a response letter to a deeply romantic letter received from [Partner Name]. Match their emotional depth and vulnerability. Acknowledge specific things they said (referenced as [Specific Point 1] and [Specific Point 2]), reciprocate your own vulnerability, and end with a shared vision for your future together.
prompts.usageInstructions: Unlock and handwrite your reply for maximum impact.

prompts.title: Reply After an Argument — Reconciliation
prompts.description: Break the ice after a fight with a warm first message.
prompts.text: Write a reconciliation opener text to [Partner Name] after our argument about [Topic]. Don't re-litigate the fight—acknowledge the tension, express that I value our relationship above the argument, and signal willingness to talk when they're ready. Keep it short, sincere, and non-pressuring.
prompts.usageInstructions: Give them a few hours of space before sending this.

prompts.title: Reply for a Boy to a Girl — Compliment Response
prompts.description: A genuine, confident reply to a compliment from a crush.
prompts.text: Write 5 natural, confident replies for a boy receiving a compliment from a girl he likes. Avoid: being arrogant, deflecting too much, or being overly eager. Strike the balance of gracious confidence. Include one reply that turns the compliment back to her, and one that opens a playful conversation.
prompts.usageInstructions: Choose the reply that matches your personality.

prompts.title: Reply for a Girl to a Boy — Sweet Response
prompts.description: A charming, genuine reply from a girl to a romantic message.
prompts.text: Write 5 warm, genuine replies for a girl to a romantic good-night message from a boy she likes. Each reply should feel natural and not scripted. Include tones: shy and sweet, playfully teasing, deeply affectionate, curious (asking a personal question back), and poetic.
prompts.usageInstructions: Pick the tone that feels most like you.

prompts.title: Late-Night Romantic Chat Starter
prompts.description: Begin a deep, romantic late-night conversation.
prompts.text: Write 6 late-night conversation starters for a romantic chat with [Partner Name]. Each should invite a meaningful, intimate exchange: one about dreams, one about a shared memory, one about deepest fear, one about the future, one lighthearted, and one that leads to "truth or dare" territory.
prompts.usageInstructions: Use one per late-night conversation to keep things fresh.

prompts.title: Reply to "What Are We?" — Relationship Status Conversation
prompts.description: Navigate the defining-the-relationship conversation with maturity.
prompts.text: Write two mature, honest reply options to the question "What are we?" from [Partner Name]. Option A: You're ready for a committed relationship — express it clearly without panic. Option B: You need more time — express it honestly without leading them on. Both should be warm, respectful, and emotionally intelligent.
prompts.usageInstructions: Unlock and use the option that reflects your honest feelings.

prompts.title: Voice Note Script — Romantic Surprise
prompts.description: A romantic voice note to send as a surprise.
prompts.text: Write a 45-second romantic voice note script for [Name] to send to [Partner] as a surprise on a random Tuesday. Capture: why I'm thinking of them right now, one specific thing about them that made me fall for them, and a small plan for the weekend. Sound spontaneous, not rehearsed.
prompts.usageInstructions: Record in a quiet room—authenticity over perfection.

prompts.title: Reply to a Long-Distance Partner
prompts.description: Warm, reassuring message for a long-distance relationship.
prompts.text: Write a reassuring and deeply loving reply message to [Long-Distance Partner Name] who expressed missing me tonight. Acknowledge the difficulty of the distance, paint a vivid picture of our next reunion, share a small moment from my day that reminded me of them, and end with a countdown or a shared virtual activity idea.
prompts.usageInstructions: Send with a photo or short video clip for extra impact.

prompts.title: Confession Message — First Time Telling Someone You Like Them
prompts.description: Find the courage to tell someone you like them.
prompts.text: Write a genuine, brave confession message for [Name] to send to their crush [Crush Name]. Express the feelings clearly and without over-explaining. Acknowledge the risk of the admission. Give them complete freedom in how they respond. Tone: vulnerable, honest, and genuinely warm.
prompts.usageInstructions: Read it out loud once before sending to make sure it sounds like you.

prompts.title: Anniversary Surprise Countdown Text Series
prompts.description: 7 daily texts building up to an anniversary surprise.
prompts.text: Write a 7-day countdown text message series for [Name] to send to [Partner] leading up to their anniversary surprise on Day 7. Each daily text should build excitement: Day 1: a cryptic hint, Day 2: a memory, Day 3: a love fact, Day 4: a "guess the activity" riddle, Day 5: a promise, Day 6: packing instructions, Day 7: the big reveal.
prompts.usageInstructions: Schedule texts to send at a consistent daily time.

prompts.title: 5-Year Personal Vision Board Script
prompts.description: Build your ideal 5-year life vision with guided prompts.
prompts.text: Guide [Name] through creating a detailed 5-year personal vision board across 8 life dimensions: Career, Finances, Health, Relationships, Travel, Personal Growth, Contribution to Society, and Spiritual/Mental Peace. For each dimension, generate 2-3 vivid, aspirational vision statements and 1 key milestone for Year 1.
prompts.usageInstructions: Complete and revisit every 6 months.

prompts.title: Retirement Planning Conversation Starter
prompts.description: Prompts to start planning for retirement early.
prompts.text: Generate a structured retirement planning conversation guide for [Name] aged [Current Age] targeting retirement at [Target Age]. Cover: current savings rate, required corpus, investment vehicles (PPF, NPS, mutual funds), lifestyle expectations, health insurance, and the first 3 actions to take this month.
prompts.usageInstructions: Discuss with a certified financial planner.

prompts.title: Dream Home Vision Document
prompts.description: Define your dream home with clarity.
prompts.text: Help [Name] create a detailed dream home vision document. Include: type (apartment/villa/townhouse), city/country, number of bedrooms, must-have features, architectural style, neighbourhood feel, estimated budget, and a timeline for purchase. Generate 5 powerful "dream home affirmations" to read daily.
prompts.usageInstructions: Save and share with your real estate agent.

prompts.title: 10-Year Financial Freedom Roadmap
prompts.description: A concrete roadmap toward financial independence.
prompts.text: Create a 10-year financial freedom roadmap for [Name] with a current income of [Income] and monthly expenses of [Expenses]. Include: emergency fund goal, debt elimination plan, investment allocation strategy (equity/debt/gold), passive income streams to build, and year-by-year net worth milestones. Reference the FIRE (Financial Independence Retire Early) framework.
prompts.usageInstructions: Unlock and review with a SEBI-registered financial advisor.

prompts.title: Career Pivot 3-Year Plan
prompts.description: A structured plan for changing careers in 3 years.
prompts.text: Design a 3-year career pivot plan for [Name] moving from [Current Field] to [Target Field]. Year 1: skill acquisition and side projects. Year 2: portfolio building and first clients/roles. Year 3: full-time transition. Include specific certifications, communities, and tools for each year.
prompts.usageInstructions: Review progress every quarter and adjust the plan.

prompts.title: Family Life Plan — Starting a Family
prompts.description: A thoughtful plan for couples considering starting a family.
prompts.text: Write a thoughtful family life planning guide for [Name1] and [Name2] considering starting a family. Cover: financial readiness checklist, relationship readiness conversation (values alignment, parenting styles, division of labour), health and wellness preparation, and a 12-month pre-baby timeline.
prompts.usageInstructions: Complete together during a distraction-free evening.

prompts.title: Travel Bucket List for Life
prompts.description: Build your ultimate lifetime travel bucket list.
prompts.text: Create a personalised lifetime travel bucket list for [Name] with [Budget Range] per year available for travel. Include: 5 dream "once in a lifetime" destinations, 5 annual "near home" adventure trips, 3 cultural immersion experiences, and 2 solo travel challenges. For each, include the ideal season to visit.
prompts.usageInstructions: Start planning the nearest location on the list this year.

prompts.title: Legacy Letter — What I Want to Leave Behind
prompts.description: Define your life legacy with intention.
prompts.text: Write a personal legacy letter for [Name] defining what they want to be remembered for. Sections: values I lived by, impact I had on specific people, work I'm proud of, lessons I want to pass on, and the one sentence I want on my legacy statement. Guided by questions like "What breaks my heart about the world I want to heal?"
prompts.usageInstructions: Unlock and revisit annually on your birthday.

prompts.title: Business Launch 90-Day Sprint Plan
prompts.description: A 90-day business launch roadmap for new entrepreneurs.
prompts.text: Create a 90-day business launch sprint plan for [Name]'s [Business Type] business. Week-by-week breakdown: Weeks 1-2 (Research & Validation), Weeks 3-5 (MVP Build), Weeks 6-8 (Soft Launch & Feedback), Weeks 9-12 (First Revenue Target & Iteration). Include key metrics to track each phase.
prompts.usageInstructions: Print and check off each weekly milestone.

prompts.title: Digital Detox and Life Redesign Plan
prompts.description: Plan a meaningful reduction in screen time and digital dependency.
prompts.text: Create a 30-day digital detox and life redesign plan for [Name]. Week 1: audit and reduce. Week 2: replace digital time with physical activities. Week 3: deep work immersion. Week 4: design new sustainable digital habits. Include daily schedules, app-blocking strategies, and offline hobby suggestions.
prompts.usageInstructions: Share your plan with an accountability partner.

prompts.title: Yearly Review & Annual Goal Setting Template
prompts.description: A comprehensive year-end review and next-year planning template.
prompts.text: Guide [Name] through a comprehensive year-end review for [Year]. Sections: Year in Review (greatest wins, hardest lessons, biggest surprises, relationships that grew), Annual Assessment (scores for each life area 1-10), and Goal Setting for [Next Year] (3 goals per life area with specific OKRs). End with a single theme word for the new year.
prompts.usageInstructions: Schedule this as a 2-3 hour self-retreat on 31st December.

prompts.title: Education Plan for Children
prompts.description: A thoughtful education roadmap for a child's future.
prompts.text: Create an education planning roadmap for [Child Name], aged [Age]. Cover: current schooling assessment, extra-curricular development plan, competitive exam preparation timeline (e.g., [Exam]), higher education target (domestic vs international), and a financial planning framework (Education fund/SIP) to fund this plan.
prompts.usageInstructions: Review annually with the child's involvement from age 10+.

prompts.title: Side Hustle to Full-Time Business Plan
prompts.description: Transition from employee to entrepreneur with a clear plan.
prompts.text: Write a transition-to-full-time business plan for [Name] who currently earns [Side Income] monthly from [Side Business] and needs [Minimum Monthly Revenue] to replace their salary. Include: the revenue milestone trigger for quitting, how to de-risk the transition, a 6-month runway plan, and the 3 most important growth levers.
prompts.usageInstructions: Unlock and review with a mentor before making any employment changes.

prompts.title: Health & Fitness 1-Year Transformation Plan
prompts.description: A structured fitness and health transformation roadmap.
prompts.text: Create a 1-year health and fitness transformation plan for [Name] with current metrics: weight [Weight], goal [Goal Weight], fitness level [Beginner/Intermediate]. Divide into 4 quarterly phases: Foundation, Build, Intensity, Maintenance. Include workout types, dietary guidelines, and monthly milestone targets.
prompts.usageInstructions: Consult a doctor before starting if you have any health conditions.

prompts.title: Mind Map for Life Purpose Discovery
prompts.description: A structured mind-mapping exercise to discover your life purpose.
prompts.text: Guide [Name] through a life purpose discovery mind map using the Japanese Ikigai framework. Map four intersecting circles: What I Love, What I'm Good At, What the World Needs, What I Can Be Paid For. Generate 5 exploration questions for each circle and identify where they overlap—that's the Ikigai zone.
prompts.usageInstructions: Draw this on a large whiteboard or use Miro/FigJam.

prompts.title: 7-Day Vegetarian Meal Plan for Beginners
prompts.description: A simple, balanced weekly meal plan for vegetarians.
prompts.text: Create a 7-day vegetarian meal plan for [Name] targeting [Calorie Goal] calories per day. Include breakfast, lunch, snack, and dinner for each day. Meals should be simple, affordable, and nutritionally balanced with adequate protein (from lentils, paneer, tofu, eggs-optional). Include a shopping list for the week.
prompts.usageInstructions: Prep ingredients for 2-3 meals in advance each Sunday.

prompts.title: Keto Diet 30-Day Starter Plan
prompts.description: A structured ketogenic diet launch plan for beginners.
prompts.text: Create a 30-day ketogenic diet starter plan for [Name] aiming for [Goal: weight loss/energy/mental clarity]. Include: daily macros breakdown (fat/protein/carbs), a 2-week rotating meal plan, permitted foods list, foods to avoid, electrolyte management, and common keto flu symptoms with remedies.
prompts.usageInstructions: Consult your doctor if you have diabetes or kidney conditions.

prompts.title: Intermittent Fasting Schedule Customiser
prompts.description: Find your ideal intermittent fasting window.
prompts.text: Create a personalised intermittent fasting schedule for [Name] with [Work Schedule] and [Sleep Time]. Explain the difference between 16:8, 18:6, 5:2, and OMAD protocols. Recommend the best fit based on their lifestyle, and provide a sample daily eating window with meal timing for the chosen protocol.
prompts.usageInstructions: Start with a 12-hour fast and gradually extend over 2 weeks.

prompts.title: Nutrition Plan for Gym Beginners (Bulking)
prompts.description: A muscle-building nutrition guide for gym starters.
prompts.text: Create a bulking nutrition plan for [Name] weighing [Weight]kg with a goal of gaining [X]kg of lean muscle in [Timeframe]. Calculate daily caloric surplus, protein requirement, and provide a 5-meal structure with high-protein food options. Include pre- and post-workout meal recommendations and supplement guidance (protein powder, creatine).
prompts.usageInstructions: Track macros using MyFitnessPal or a similar app.

prompts.title: Daily Fruit Intake Guide
prompts.description: Which fruits to eat daily for optimal health.
prompts.text: Create a guide to the best fruits for daily consumption for [Name] with goals of [Goal: energy/immunity/skin health/weight loss]. For each of 10 recommended fruits, provide: best time to eat, portion size, key nutritional benefit, and who should avoid it (allergies, conditions). Include a seasonal fruits calendar for [Region].
prompts.usageInstructions: Aim for 2 servings of fruit daily, preferably before noon.

prompts.title: Indian Diet Plan for Weight Loss
prompts.description: A calorie-controlled Indian diet plan for sustainable weight loss.
prompts.text: Create a 4-week Indian diet plan for [Name] weighing [Weight] targeting a loss of [X]kg. Use traditional Indian foods: dal, sabzi, roti, curd, rice (limited), salad. Specify portion sizes in cups/katoris. Avoid ultra-processed foods. Include: morning detox routine, healthy Indian snack options, and cheat day guidance.
prompts.usageInstructions: Weigh yourself once a week only, not daily.

prompts.title: Kids Lunchbox Meal Ideas (Week Plan)
prompts.description: Nutritious and kid-friendly lunchbox ideas for the school week.
prompts.text: Create a 5-day school lunchbox plan for a [Age]-year-old child with no allergy restrictions (or specify [Allergies]). Each lunch should include: a main item, a fruit, a healthy snack, and a drink. Focus on portability, no reheating needed, balanced nutrition, and foods kids actually enjoy. Include prep tips for busy parents.
prompts.usageInstructions: Prep ingredients on Sunday evening to save morning time.

prompts.title: Post-Illness Recovery Diet Plan
prompts.description: Nutrition guide to recover faster after illness.
prompts.text: Create a 10-day post-illness recovery diet plan for [Name] recovering from [Illness, e.g., fever/viral/surgery]. Day 1-3: liquid and semi-solid phase. Day 4-7: light solid foods. Day 8-10: gradual return to normal eating. Include immunity-boosting foods, foods to avoid, hydration targets, and supplement suggestions (zinc, Vitamin C, probiotics).
prompts.usageInstructions: Always follow your doctor's dietary guidelines during illness recovery.

prompts.title: Vegan Protein Sources Deep Dive
prompts.description: Complete guide to protein for plant-based eaters.
prompts.text: Create a comprehensive vegan protein guide for [Name] targeting [Daily Protein Goal]g of protein per day. List 20 plant-based protein sources with protein content per 100g serving, best cooking methods, and protein bioavailability. Include 3 high-protein vegan meal examples that hit 30g+ protein per meal.
prompts.usageInstructions: Combine different protein sources throughout the day for complete amino acid profiles.

prompts.title: Diabetes-Friendly Meal Plan (Type 2)
prompts.description: A blood sugar-controlled meal plan for Type 2 diabetes management.
prompts.text: Create a 7-day diabetes-friendly meal plan for [Name] managing Type 2 diabetes. Each meal must prioritise: low glycaemic index foods, adequate fibre, controlled carbohydrate portions (no more than [X]g per meal), and balanced macros. Include a food label reading guide and tips for eating out safely.
prompts.usageInstructions: Unlock and implement under the guidance of a registered dietitian.

prompts.title: Hydration Tracker & Habit Builder
prompts.description: Build a consistent daily hydration habit.
prompts.text: Create a personalised daily hydration plan for [Name] weighing [Weight]kg with [Activity Level: sedentary/active/highly active]. Calculate their daily water intake target. Suggest a time-blocked hydration schedule, flavoured water recipes to make it enjoyable, and signs of dehydration vs overhydration to watch for.
prompts.usageInstructions: Use a 1-litre bottle and track daily on your phone notes.

prompts.title: Anti-Inflammatory Diet Shopping List
prompts.description: A weekly shopping list for an anti-inflammatory diet.
prompts.text: Create a comprehensive anti-inflammatory diet shopping list for [Name] for one week. Organise by category: vegetables, fruits, whole grains, legumes, healthy fats, proteins, herbs and spices, and drinks. For each category, highlight the top 3 anti-inflammatory champions and explain their key compounds (e.g., curcumin in turmeric, omega-3 in salmon).
prompts.usageInstructions: Shop the perimeter of the supermarket first for fresh produce.

prompts.title: Gut Health 21-Day Reset Plan
prompts.description: Heal and reset your gut microbiome in 21 days.
prompts.text: Create a 21-day gut health reset plan for [Name]. Phase 1 (Days 1-7): Elimination (remove processed foods, sugar, alcohol).
